transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We've got 120 returned servo drives from the customer to review for possible remanufacture. Before I can sign off on the work order, I need to hear from each area — quality on serial traceability, EHS on the electrical hazard screening, and remanufacturing on the documented remanufacturing plan. Let's go through your go-or-no-go updates so I can make the disposition decision. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I've completed the serial-number reconciliation. Of the 120 returned drives, 96 have complete service histories and are eligible for remanufacture. The remaining 24 lack traceability and must stay quarantined. The reconciliation report is still in the quality review queue and hasn't reached Elena's release packet yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: EHS update: my battery-screening inspection found swollen lithium backup cells in exactly 18 of the 120 returned drives. Those cells require a certified isolation procedure lasting exactly 2 hours before any remanufacturing work can begin. My inspection worksheet is awaiting attachment to the EHS case.
